criteria.pass_when: Already-open N and new N+1 connections read their own wire shapes and observe writes from both protocols before and after backfill. Each write updates raw and minor atomically. Unsupported protocol reads and writes raise ValueError without changing database state.
criteria.evidence: Executed reads/writes through both connections, including negative amount and original text preservation; unsupported read/write evidence includes ValueError and unchanged database state. A connection-open check alone is insufficient. Establish atomicity with transaction-boundary evidence or instrumentation that establishes those boundaries; final values or absence of intermediate samples alone are insufficient. Report atomicity as unverified when the available channel cannot establish it.

criteria.pass_when: Each incomplete migrate_step call transforms exactly the next existing row in ID order and commits its checkpoint with that row, returning exactly True. Completed calls return exactly False without changes. Interrupted is a RuntimeError subtype; interruption after the row update but before checkpoint rolls back both. Reopen the same database, finish all rows, then repeat without omissions, duplicates or value changes.
criteria.evidence: Per-call row/checkpoint observations and exact boolean results across close/reopen, including exact final records. Establish row/checkpoint commit atomicity from transaction boundaries or report it unverified; final records, a fresh database or only clean success are insufficient.

criteria.pass_when: Incomplete backfill cannot finalize. After draining clients and freezing writes, create and verify a pre-loss snapshot, finalize irreversibly while retaining every ID and minor-unit value, persist phase='final', and serve correct protocol-2 reads. Reject retired protocol and writes, restore, and recover exact original text. Snapshot remains usable.
criteria.evidence: Executed destructive step on disposable data, evidence raw no longer exists, and exact finalized records, final phase and protocol-2 reads across close/reopen before restoration. Then verify restoration including 001.20 and preservation of the snapshot. Successful restoration alone does not establish a correct finalized state. Formatting 120 as 1.20 or lowering a schema version is not recovery.

criteria.pass_when: Report synthetic/offline evidence and missing native-product evidence accurately; no installation, deployment or production reads/writes.
criteria.evidence: Complete tool and user observations plus tests; omitted observation channels are unverified, not a pass.
